entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Cannot scaffold migration with index on JSON complex property: RelationalJsonIndex literal not supported #39430
  • Query precompiler aliases Skip and Take into a single SQL parameter #39429
  • Query precompiler folds conditionals on captured variables using fake defaults and drops a SQL branch #39428
  • NativeAOT: precompiled queries over enum or collection parameters throw NativeAotNoCompiledModel #39427
  • Precompiled ExecuteUpdate reads multi-setter values in reverse order, writing them to the wrong columns #39426
  • EF Core 10 materializes an owned entity with a null required property for a sibling derived entity #39425

Closed

  • EF Core 8 & 9 throw when "external" sets of primitive types are included in select #35568
    12.0-preview1
  • Migrations command in incorrect order when dealing with sequences #33130
    11.0-preview7
  • Migration: Make existing column which has a unique index nullable fails #25083
    12.0-preview1
  • Compiled query with a parameterized temporal point-in-time throws ArgumentException from ExpressionTreeFuncletizer #38851
    12.0-preview1
  • Change Path.Combine to Path.Join in tools #36754
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Don't rewrite Any/All to Contains when the item references the lambda parameter #39433
    community-contribution
  • [release/8.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.37.1 to 3.63.3 #39432
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/8.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.31 to 8.0.33 #39431
    area-infrastructure
  • Get table alias out of subquery when owned entity projected with CROSS APPLY #39424
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix GetRelationalModel race condition #39423

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39409
  • Make parameter collection projections that cannot be materialized untranslatable so they get client eval #39349
    community-contribution
  • Add test for dropping sequence and making dependant column independant #39408
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39399
  • [release/11.0]: Bump FSharp.Core from 11.0.100 to 11.0.101 #39392
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.19.1 to 1.20.0 #39394
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26514.118 to 11.0.0-beta.26523.3 #39393
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39407
  • Fix migrations alter column with referenced index filter #39323
    community-contribution
  • Report a guided error for temporal operators in compiled queries #38852
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Use Path.Join for relative path composition in tools #39401
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Cosmos datetime fixed width #39131
    community-contribution
  • Report command failures while reading results #39405
    community-contribution
  • Translate grouping aggregates as window functions behind an opt-in #39240
    community-contribution
  • Add NOT NULL for persisted computed column if the column is not nullable #39417
    community-contribution
  • Visit each IN value once when compensating for nullable values #39414
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39400
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39391
  • Support GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP and CUBE via EF.Functions in GroupBy key selectors #39362
    community-contribution
  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / upsert support #39100
    community-contribution
  • Compare converted reference-type identifiers by their provider values #39369
    community-contribution
